title: Start and Stop Codons
text: AUG is the universal start codon (codes for Methionine). UGA, UAA, and UAG are stop codons that signal the ribosome to release the polypeptide.

title: Building the Polypeptide
text: tRNA anticodons pair with mRNA codons, bringing amino acids in order: AUG brings Met, GCU brings Ala, UAC brings Tyr. UGA stops translation - this amino acid is not added.
